title: blender-clothing-pose-diagnostics
summary: Diagnose and locally repair animation-driven clothing clipping in Blender using component-color isolation, evaluated skeletal deformation, multi-pose clearance indicators, skin-derived weight transfer, and matching separate seam weights. Use for clothing or crotch patches that fit at rest but open during running, leg lifts, or posing. This is controlled-pose skinning analysis, not cloth physics or a guarantee of collision-free game animation.
